create_optimizer_rmsprop: create an RMSprop optimizer instance with configurable learning rate, momentum, and weight decay
configure_centered_rmsprop: configure RMSprop with centered mode to normalize gradient by variance estimation
add_momentum_to_rmsprop: add momentum factor to RMSprop optimizer for accelerated convergence
apply_weight_decay_rmsprop: apply L2 weight decay penalty to RMSprop optimizer parameters
run_rmsprop_step: run a single RMSprop optimization step on model parameters with gradients
